title: Dental PPO Plans Network Access and Allowance Provisions
content:
For each of the Dental PPO Plans, the schedule below states whether Premier practices count as in network, which allowance is used for out-of-network lines, and whether the two alternate-benefit provisions apply.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Premier network access | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Out-of-network allowance basis | Cascade PPO fee schedule | Cascade PPO fee schedule | Cascade PPO fee schedule | Cascade Premier fee schedule | Usual and customary, 80th percentile | Usual and customary, 90th percentile |
| Posterior composite alternate benefit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Molar crown alternate benefit | No | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |

**Premier network access.** "Yes" means practices holding a Cascade Premier Participating Dentist Agreement count as in network (Premier in-network) for the plan. "No" means such practices are paid as out of network.

**Out-of-network allowance basis.** The allowance used for out-of-network lines: the Cascade PPO fee schedule for the practice ZIP code, the Premier fee schedule, or the Cascade usual-and-customary table at the 80th or 90th percentile. The practice may balance-bill the difference.

**Posterior composite alternate benefit.** "Yes" means posterior composite fillings are paid on the amalgam allowance (the alternate allowance recorded on the line).

**Molar crown alternate benefit.** "Yes" means porcelain or ceramic crowns on molars are paid on the full-cast base-metal crown allowance (the alternate allowance recorded on the line).

### Reading example
A tooth-colored filling on a back tooth is paid on the amalgam allowance under Value 1000, Classic 1250 and Plus 1500, and on its own allowance under Premier 2000 and Elite 2500; under Preventive 750 fillings are not a covered service class.
